decisions.reason: As a new dietary-supplement line closely related to the firm’s existing consumer-health capabilities and given dedicated web presentation, it fits the firm’s knowledge base and is likely to be improved rather than withdrawn.
This skin-and-hair supplement builds on established adjacent know-how and was actively launched, so a large R&D-performing pharmaceutical firm would usually keep it and learn from early sales.

The joint-health supplement is still close to the firm’s portfolio and absorptive capacity, and despite more limited visibility than A or B it is more likely to be retained and refined than dropped quickly.

Although this immune supplement is related to the established offer, its lighter market presence and more niche positioning make it somewhat more vulnerable, but the firm would still likely keep it for now.

This generic blood-pressure medicine is described as distant from the firm’s established offer and already showed a market problem in 2018, so under the absorptive-capacity logic management is relatively likely to withdraw it rather than commit further resources.
